Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1301); Barak, an Israelite:--Barak.
BiblicalUsage: Barak's name reaches the New Testament in the roll of faith. Hebrews says time would fail to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, and Jephthah, who through faith subdued kingdoms.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Barak is remembered in Hebrews because he went when Deborah told him to go, and faith that obeys a prophet's word is the kind God writes down.
